environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on the same EC2 architecture, but the ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-geo-restrict' that blocks non-US source IPs (action: BLOCK), and (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode and sensitivity level set to HIGH, with scope-down statement matching URI path /api/*. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the EC2 instance runs with a read-only filesystem mount for /var/data/ (EBS volume mounted with 'ro' flag in fstab), and the application's SQLite database is opened in read-only mode via the URI 'file:/var/data/users.db?mode=ro'. The security group restricts inbound to the ALB security group only (no direct access).
